notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI implements a standalone 1.12-style Key Bindings window (Program.Keybindings.cs): six-piece UI-KeyBindingFrame art, category headers, 17-row scrolling list with vanilla scrollbar, dual key capsules per command, click-to-arm capture, silent key-steal from other commands, Unbind, Reset To Default, Okay/Cancel with snapshot revert, and a Character Specific Key Bindings checkbox. Benilla instead embeds keybindings as an Options-window category (era 1.15 structure, live-commit, collapsible sections, search).

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Structural divergence for Nico's ruling: Benilla (decision 1008) moved keybindings INSIDE the Options window with live-commit; MSUI keeps 1.12's standalone KeyBindingFrame with Okay/Cancel - arguably closer to the 1.12 reference than Benilla is. Not scored as a gap; the concrete capture-law gaps above are.
